blocks.x: When you’re braving the great outdoors, what you wear really matters. Whether you’re hiking in a US national park or skiing in the Dolomites, you need protective layers and durable gear that can keep up with you. That’s where Helly Hansen comes in: an editor-loved brand designing smart, technical clothing and gear for over 140 years. From winter jackets and ski pants to waterproof duffels and trail shoes, Helly Hansen's extensive selection of outdoor essentials is gearde toward active travelers. And with its price point, the brand proves you don’t need to break the bank to get your hands on quality gear for your next ski or snowboarding trip. To help you save even more on your next order, I’ve rounded up all the best Helly Hansen promo codes and deals on offer right now. From the brand’s fall sale to its new customer offer, there are plenty of ways to save with these Helly Hansen discounts.
Get a Helly Hansen discount code for 15% off your first order with email sign-up

New to Helly Hansen? Then you’re in luck: The brand is offering a discount code for 15% off your first order when you join Helly Hansen’s email list. Once you sign up, your unique Helly Hansen discount code can be used sitewide, whether you’re shopping for insulated jackets, hiking pants, or rain boots. These emails will help keep you updated on the latest sales, clearance events, and special discounts. This offer is valid through December 31, 2026.
Save up to 50% without a Helly Hansen promo code in the sale

Just in time for fall and winter trips, Helly Hansen’s seasonal sale is here and packed with discounts of up to 50% off. Head to the brand’s sale section to shop deals on waterproof jackets, packable puffers, lightweight pullovers, and more performance clothing. Lots of ski essentials are part of the sale too—from ski pants and jackets to kids’ insulated ski bibs. But hurry: Select sizes and colorways may sell out quickly, so don’t delay snagging something you see on sale.
Student, military, healthcare, and first responder discounts: up to 15% off

As a simple thank you, Helly Hansen is offering special discounts of up to 15% off for military personnel, first responders, and healthcare workers. To claim this discount, your credentials can be verified through a secure third-party platform like ID.me or SheerID. Students can also take advantage of the offer by verifying their status. It’s worth noting that these special Helly Hansen community discounts cannot be combined with other seasonal sales or promo codes.
Get free shipping and more savings on Helly Hansen orders

Looking to save even more on your Helly Hansen order? Shoppers can unlock free standard shipping when they spend $99 or more. If you’re shopping for new ski gear or jackets, there’s a good chance you’ll hit that minimum spend easily and earn free shipping. If not, pool an order with a friend or family member to hit the threshold needed to avoid shipping fees. Keep an eye out for seasonal promotions that may offer free shipping without a minimum spend requirement.
Why your Helly Hansen promo code may not work and how to fix it

If your Helly Hansen promo code isn’t working, there are a few simple things you can do to troubleshoot the issue. For starters, double check that you’ve entered the promo code correctly. Look for extra spaces, incorrect capitalization, and any other typos. Next, check to make sure your order meets any minimum spend requirement necessary to unlock the deal. You’ll also want to check that the promo code hasn’t expired and that you’re not trying to apply it to an item that’s already on sale. If everything looks good, try clearing your cache and refresh the page. Shoppers can also reach out to Helly Hansen’s customer service for additional support.
